'''Pax Teem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He represented the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

At some point, [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], considered Teem for the role of figurehead [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] he and his apprentice, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], could manipulate into office. After a falling out between Teem and Plagueis's public persona Hego Damask, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Plagueis's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and the person who eventually became the Sith-backed Chancellor instead of Teem, was targeted by the Gran Senator.

In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], Teem, joining forces with [[Santhe Security]], organized Palpatine's kidnapping and an [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attack]] against [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]]. Pax Teem was murdered, along with his family and friends, by Palpatine himself while celebrating his assumed victory. He was succeeded in the Senate by his aide, [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]], and [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]].

==Biography==
===Senator===
Pax Teem became the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] sometime prior to [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]]. He was an avid fan of [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]], and was known to attend the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], as he did in [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]]. During that event, Senator Teem was outraged to learn that [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Magister]] of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]]&mdash;and secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Plagueis&mdash;sponsored [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] plans for taking over the remote and desolate planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and turning it into a major podracing center. Loss of podracing revenues, together with the discovery of a vast [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] source on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] which might undercut Malastare's fuel exports, had the potential to seriously affect the Protectorate's finances.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

===Dealings with the Sith===
After [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] succeeded [[Vidar Kim]] as Senate representative of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] in [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], Senator Teem approached him with hopes that he might serve him as crony of the Protectorate. Unbeknownst to Teem, Palpatine was secretly Darth Sidious, apprentice to Plagueis, the alter ego of Hego Damask. After spotting Palpatine and Damask engaged in friendly conversation with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] prior to a [[Seating new planets vote of 52 BBY|vote]] on seating several "client worlds" of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], including [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], the Gran began seeing Palpatine as a political foe. Pax Teem was convinced both Palpatine and Damask were allies after Palpatine's abstention from the vote served the Trade Federation's interests while harming his own.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Teem joined forces with [[Santhe Security]] and organized Palpatine's kidnapping. The Naboo senator went along with it in order to slaughter his captors and prove himself to his Master, but Plagueis had other plans: he had expected this would happen, and wanted to use it as an excuse to rid himself of Teem. After Damask's [[Sun Guard]]s intervened and freed Palpatine, they went after the Gran, who was supposedly hiding in an orbital station. But Plagueis was not aware of the other part of Teem's plan: The Muun Magister was overseeing the initiation of [[Larsh Hill]] into the [[Order of the Canted Circle]] in the Order's [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi]] [[Lodge of the Canted Circle|Lodge]], and Teem had hired [[Maladian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] to infiltrate the Order and murder all participants, with Damask as the prime target. Plagueis, the only one to eventually survive [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|the attack]], and his Sun Guards fought off several assassins before Palpatine and [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] arrived.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

===Death===
When the Sun Guards discovered that Teem was hosting a party in the [[Gran Protectorate Embassy]], Sidious set out to kill him. He [[Massacre at the Gran Protectorate Embassy|slaughtered]] everyone in eyesight, including the guests that Teem had invited to a feast. Leaving Teem for last, he used the Force to [[Pyrokinesis|set fire]] to a floor-to-ceiling curtain under which the Gran had taken refuge, killing him. By [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Teem had been succeeded by his aide, Aks Moe, and [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Personality==
Pax Teem was a cruel politiican who was not heistiant to use methods such as murder and kidnapping to achieve his goals. He was also incredibly vain and boastful, as he hoated a party to celebrate his percieved victory when he believed that he had achieved his goals. However, despite his percieved ruthlessness, he ultimatetly proved to be a coward, as he was absolutely terrified by the sight of a lightsaber-wielding Darth Sidious, gawking at him af if he were ap apparition form a nightmare. Teem then desperately begged for his life before Palpatine set him ablaze, further cementing his status as a coward.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
